scope: Final directly read batch of ten remaining GitHub originals; completes sixty original bodies outside the separately completed batch-script source.
linked_reference_caveat: Original bodies were read fully; references, helpers and concrete task inputs still require review. No live operation is authorized.

sources.workflow: Implement actual Quarkus tests and, where required, start matching local dependencies through Dev Services; distinguish injected framework tests from packaged-artifact integration tests.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Version-matched JDK, Quarkus project/dependencies and build tools; Docker/Podman for chosen Dev Services. Real packaged integration tests need the correct Failsafe configuration and skip flags.
sources.offline_assessment: Potential offline framework tests with staged dependencies, but current image lacks Java and exposes no host Docker socket. No project is selected. Mock CDI tests do not establish a real dependency service, and a passing test command cannot stand in for skipped integration tests.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Run actual tests under the pinned version, verify the expected tests really ran, independently inspect service connections and rollback/resource lifecycle, and execute packaged-artifact tests separately when claimed.

sources.workflow: Build and test an actual Quarkus native executable, construct a container image or generate deployment manifests for the explicitly requested branch.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Real project, version-matched Java/build dependencies, Mandrel/GraalVM or isolated container builder, compatible execution platform and sufficient memory. Image builds and deployments have separate runtime/registry/cluster prerequisites.
sources.offline_assessment: Local native compilation does not inherently need a live cloud account, but exceeds the current image's tools and 128 MiB memory. Manifest-only generation is a narrower permitted branch and does not prove a running application. No target is selected; native binary existence, image push and deployment are distinct results.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Execute the actual native binary and integration tests on a compatible platform; separately inspect/run built images or validate generated manifests. Deployment claims require real isolated cluster evidence, never a stub or live shared-resource test.

sources.workflow: Implement a collaborator's actual shorthand or incomplete description as functioning code, resolving genuine uncertainty and removing implemented shorthand markers.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Concrete shorthand input, target language/runtime, surrounding project contracts and tests. The source's confidence percentages are guidance, not independently calibrated probabilities.
sources.offline_assessment: Potential offline implementation in the existing Python runtime after selecting a suitable public incomplete-code input. No input is selected. Merely deleting markers is not functional completion, and broad production-quality claims need a declared, testable boundary rather than a subjective label.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Execute independently specified normal and edge cases, verify preserved surrounding behavior, error handling and actual marker replacement. Retain genuine clarification when intent is ambiguous; do not fabricate author expertise or approvals.

sources.workflow: Rebase an actual clean feature branch onto the identified freshly fetched upstream default branch while preserving commits and any user work.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Git, actual local repository/remotes/default-branch identity and a clean worktree or genuine user decision about changes. Validation hooks are optional and require user agreement under this workflow.
sources.offline_assessment: An isolated local bare remote could support a genuine offline fetch/rebase without a hosting account. Current image lacks Git and no licensed repository input is selected. Updating text refs or simulating command output does not demonstrate a real rebase; never use the shared study worktree as the experimental target.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Inspect real commit graphs, patch/content preservation, ancestry and worktree state before/after; verify fetched branch identity and any actual conflict handling. Do not push, auto-stash or discard changes to manufacture success.

sources.workflow: Complete an actual provider detection, intelligence, watermark or identity operation and report its returned status and probabilistic result without inventing media authenticity.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Authorized external API account/key and exact reference schema; public media access for media endpoints, while the text endpoint accepts inline text but still needs the actual service and applicable entitlement.
sources.offline_assessment: Not faithfully executable in the current no-network/no-credentials runtime by substituting stubs. Inline text is not an offline exception to service use. A canned score or self-authored classifier is not a completed provider detection, and the source disallows authenticity claims without such a result. No live operation is authorized.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Require actual completed service/job evidence and exact response reconciliation for the selected operation, with independent provenance checks and explicit probabilistic limits. These are analytical results, not authenticity proofs or legal certification.

sources.workflow: Run the installed Ruff on a declared project scope, iteratively review safe and permitted unsafe fixes, format and recheck until clean or an explicitly reported decision block.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Actual Python project/configuration and compatible installed Ruff runner. Multiple valid choices require genuine decisions; unavailable tools are a stop condition rather than implicit permission to install.
sources.offline_assessment: Potential offline task in a reviewed image containing pinned Ruff; current execution image lacks third-party tools even though Ruff exists on the host. No public project is selected. Suppressing all rules, passing a zero-file check or replacing code with a trivial stub would not meet semantic preservation or the requested scope.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Run actual Ruff with the frozen scope/options, confirm nonempty expected files and format status, inspect actual diffs and execute behavior tests. Retain decisions and legitimate remaining blockers rather than forcing an all-clear.

sources.workflow: Produce a draft first-pass prioritized brief over supplied public review rows using the declared keyword, secondary-match, uncertainty and provenance rules.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Actual permitted public rows or an explicitly disclosed reuse of the source's fictional worked example, supplied dates/ownership context and an independent rubric. Human-checked promotion needs actual human verification, not inference.
sources.offline_assessment: The first-pass drafting branch is genuinely offline and explicitly forbids fetching reviews or contacting anyone. No input is selected. The embedded eight rows are fictional public example data, not observed merchant reports. Source links must be preserved through model guarding/restoration; private support data and invented links, human checks or claimed defects are not allowed.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Independently apply normalization and bucket precedence, verify each row appears once with correct secondary matches, counts and supplied provenance. Check provisional/first-pass status, age/competitor/escalation rules under an explicit date contract and no invented reviewer identity or reproduction result.

sources.workflow: Update or add a real Markdown file index from actual matching directory entries, preserving surrounding document structure and generating correctly escaped relative links and descriptions.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Target Markdown document, concrete directory/pattern and actual candidate files. Optional sizes and modification dates need not be included unless requested.
sources.offline_assessment: Strong standard-library offline candidate after selecting a licensed public file tree and explicit preservation/description contract. No task is frozen. A static hard-coded file list cannot establish discovery correctness, and document parsing must preserve unrelated text and special-character filenames.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Compare independently enumerated files and ordering, decode/resolve every relative link, verify descriptions against supplied source text and check byte-preserved protected regions. Replay with added/removed/special-character entries to detect hard-coded inventories.

sources.workflow: Build, test and format actual V-language code using the detected compiler version, correct module layout and explicit Option/Result behavior.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Compatible actual V compiler, target source/project and any declared packages; source behavior is version-sensitive and requires detection. Standalone programs need no manifest.
sources.offline_assessment: A standard-library V task could be offline with a reviewed compiler, but the current image lacks V and C compilation tools. No target is selected. A Python reimplementation or V-shaped source text does not establish a working V program; no source installation commands were followed during review.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Compile/run the actual target, execute its V tests and formatting/vet checks, independently compare outputs and error paths, and verify declared dependency/module constraints under the pinned compiler.

sources.workflow: Inspect an actual running site's rendered views, identify grounded layout/accessibility issues, make scoped source fixes and capture real post-fix regression evidence.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Running target, real browser navigation/screenshots and visual analysis, source access for fixes and relevant checklist/framework references. DOM retrieval is recommended; the choice of actual browser automation tool is flexible.
sources.offline_assessment: A self-contained local site can be offline with a reviewed browser runtime; no production site is necessary. Current executor lacks a browser and no public target is selected. Static CSS checks, invented screenshots or palette-only arithmetic cannot demonstrate actual responsive layout or before/after rendering.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Capture real original and repaired pages at declared viewports, independently check geometric/accessibility requirements and protected behavior, and retain actual screenshot provenance. Subjective consistency/readability requires an explicit review boundary; do not claim unobserved page coverage.
